comment: Retrieval-miss exemplars from the 2026-08-04 withheld-answer mining (cluster: governing statute in corpus but never retrieved). Each question was judged POOR because retrieval surfaced wrong-domain hits while the named statute sat in the corpus. Used by scripts/eval_retrieval_recall.rb; extend as new misses are confirmed.

cases.question: Onschendbaarheid woning?
cases.note: De gecoordineerde Grondwet, Art. 15; baseline retrieved Vienna diplomatic convention + vastgoedmakelaar deontology

cases.question: Groepsverzekering pensioen?
cases.note: WAP 28-4-2003; baseline retrieved statutory-pension KB nr. 50

cases.question: Wat is het Sociaal Strafwetboek?
cases.note: Sociaal Strafwetboek itself; baseline retrieved the NEW 2024 Strafwetboek

cases.question: Wat is een pop-up huur?
cases.note: Vlaams decreet 17-6-2016 huur korte duur handel en ambacht; baseline claimed the term has no legal meaning

cases.question: Heb ik recht om de concrete reden van mijn ontslag te kennen?
cases.note: CAO nr. 109 Art. 3 (right to the concrete reasons). Added 2026-08-05: the 2026-08-04 brief filed this cluster as outside the corpus, but CAO 109 is present with 24 ART rows. Private sector: CAO 109 Art. 2 applies to workers under an arbeidsovereenkomst; the Wet 13-3-2024 (2024002270) is the OVERHEIDSSECTOR counterpart and must not be the expected hit here

cases.question: Wat is een kennelijk onredelijk ontslag?
cases.note: CAO nr. 109 Art. 8 defines it, Art. 9 sets the compensation
